title: Login issue on mobile app
description: Customer cannot log in using Google authentication from the Android app.

title: Payment not processed
description: Payment failed during checkout but money was deducted from the bank account.

title: Profile image upload failed
description: User cannot upload a profile picture from the account settings page.

title: Password reset email not received
description: Customer requested a password reset but did not receive the email in inbox or spam.

title: Order tracking page not loading
description: Tracking page remains blank after entering the order tracking number.

title: Refund request pending too long
description: Customer requested a refund 10 days ago but the request is still pending.

title: Coupon code not applying
description: Discount coupon shows invalid even though it is still within the active campaign period.

title: Subscription canceled automatically
description: Premium subscription was canceled without any action from the customer.

title: Invoice PDF download broken
description: Invoice download button is not generating or downloading the PDF file.

title: Address update not saving
description: Customer updated shipping address but the old address still appears during checkout.

title: Website loading very slowly
description: Pages take too long to load, especially the product and checkout pages.

title: Duplicate order placed
description: Customer clicked place order once but the system created two separate orders.

title: Chat support not responding
description: Live chat opens successfully but no agent replies to customer messages.

title: Wrong product delivered
description: Customer received a different product than the one shown in the order summary.

title: App crashes on checkout
description: The mobile app closes automatically whenever the customer tries to complete checkout.

title: Notification settings not updating
description: Email and push notification preferences revert back after saving changes.

title: Promo banner overlaps content
description: Homepage promotional banner is covering product cards on smaller laptop screens.

title: OTP verification failed
description: Customer enters the correct OTP but the system still shows verification failed.

title: Gift card balance not showing
description: Gift card was redeemed successfully but the updated balance is not visible in the wallet.

title: Product review submission failed
description: Customer wrote a review and rating, but clicking submit does not save the review.
